visual_action: A static image displays white text against a plain black background. The text is presented in three separate paragraphs.

cast.name: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)
cast.evidence: The on-screen text repeatedly mentions ICE: 'ICE just killed...', 'ICE has killed...', and the final line 'These monsters are sick' refers to them.

cast.name: unnamed 26-year-old father
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states, 'ICE just killed a 26-year-old father in Maine...'

on_screen_text.text: ICE just killed a 26-year-old father in Maine while looking for a different person.
This is the second time in a week that ICE has killed someone they weren't even looking for.

editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot of text on a background.
central_claim: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is a monstrous organization that has wrongly killed two people in one week, including a 26-year-old father, while searching for other individuals.
intended_effect: To provoke anger and outrage towards ICE and portray the organization as incompetent and malevolent.
